digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 plan review – chunk and agent pool execution
propositions: Cold-cache concurrent submission of Pass-1 chunks and agents causes N redundant writes of the byte-identical system prefix, inflating effective plan-tokens by ~3.7x (7.9N vs. ideal 2.15N).
Warm-then-fan-out pattern (proven in container-bin path) should be ported to main pool: run first chunk serially to completion to prime cache, then submit remainder to 6-wide pool.
When estimated shared-prefix tokens exceed CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and call count >= 2, single warm call completes before pool submission; below gate or with single call, behavior unchanged.
Non-systemic warm-call failure degrades to direct fan-out (with that chunk's findings dropped); systemic LLMUnavailableError aborts the warm.
